purpose: Exact proposal for the acceptance manifest the owner has to accept in O-DATA: units, slices, CI, PPV sampling, hard-negative specificity, cluster keys, support targets, known-vs-blind separation, split access, annotation protocol and cost in human review items. It contains no final gold and no detector-derived sample selection.

requested_routing.effective_routing_metadata: not available to this subagent; not self-attested

binding_decision_ids.applies: point estimate ≥99% for recall / whole coverage / true PPV on the agreed main type and register slices, with support and CI published; lower CI bound ≥99% was NOT chosen

binding_decision_ids.literal: «ориентир не менее 300 независимых позитивных единиц на основной заявляемый тип/срез плюс достаточная отдельная проверка precision»
binding_decision_ids.applies: support target; small slices are never full acceptance; repetitions and template copies are not independent units

binding_decision_ids.literal: «два независимых разметчика, сначала только исходный текст/правила, без detector output; расхождения и стратифицированная проверка согласованных меток — владельцу»

binding_decision_ids.applies: «жене»-type lexical ambiguity: neither an automatic NAME nor an automatic false positive
possessive personal forms («Жениного/Олино») are positives when context confirms a person; homonym common words are not
public / fictional / stage names are protected; reported in a separate stratum so they never silently move the headline
company/product/band is not NAME by shape; no word blacklist
FIO: every identifying part of one person is protected and must be counted; a partially masked name is a partial leak, not recall
street + house + building + flat + entrance + floor are protected components; service words and allowed generic toponyms stay unmasked and unchanged; street TYPE is part of identity
checksum-invalid but person-linked identifiers are positives and must not be corrected; bare similar digits are negatives

binding_decision_ids.literal: «MASSIVE person-slot не автоматически PII NAME; NEREL any-annotation-support не настоящая PPV; clean-negative specificity не precision»
binding_decision_ids.applies: PPV must be measured on sampled POSITIVE predictions, specificity on a separate negative frame; they are never merged

binding_decision_ids.literal: CVC destinations «В любой ответ той же операции»; OTP/3DS/SMS «Да, исследовать всё семейство временных секретов»
binding_decision_ids.applies: temporary-secret types stay in the quality denominator; synthetic isolated path only; lifecycle/storage/admin/API/HITL deferred
acceptance protocol must not require new provenance API fields

binding_decision_ids.literal: «В B0/A1 утверждается точный acceptance manifest: единица подсчёта, список slices, тип CI, support, cluster ключ для повторов, budget разметки и невидимый разработчику acceptance split»
binding_decision_ids.applies: this proposal is the draft of exactly that manifest

native_v5_item_types.note: DATE is a separate non-item category and is reported separately, never folded into the ten

v6_new_types.status: registry/contract visible; NO generated v6 corpus on this host

temporary_secrets.status: no corpus; synthetic isolated fixtures only (owner P14)

not_in_scope_for_this_manifest: semantic PII classes (diagnosis, salary, conviction, person↔debt) — S2 map only, implementation needs a separate owner GO

axes.note: the frozen corpus exposes 22 case kinds used as the surface proxy; free prose / typed KV / nested JSON / document / RAG / tool-error surfaces are declared on top of them and must be mapped explicitly before a slice is called covered

slices.headline_rule: A headline recall / whole-coverage / PPV claim exists for a (type, register) slice only with ≥300 independent positive units; below that the slice is reported as DESCRIPTIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT and the type/slice stays visible in the table (never dropped, never called 100%).
primary_slice_priority: each v6 claimed type × its registered contexts

units.primary_positive_unit: one gold occurrence of one PII value of one type in one case, with its slice, its identity cluster key and its part decomposition

independence_cluster_key.value_bearing_types: (type, gold identity) — one person/number/card mentioned N times is ONE independent unit
independence_cluster_key.address: address identity key (street type + street + house + flat …), so the full address and its partial mentions in one conversation are one unit
independence_cluster_key.document_surface: (case id) for document-level claims; (conversation_id) for conversation-scope claims
independence_cluster_key.template: provenance.shape when present; the frozen v5 authored corpus has empty shape, so the fallback is (case id, pii_type, identity) and this must be recorded as a known independence limitation

units.part_unit: for NAME the occurrence expands into its identifying parts (surname, given, patronymic, initials, possessive form); whole coverage requires every part written to be protected — a masked surname with a live given name is a partial leak and scores as a miss on the part unit, never as recall
units.whole_coverage_unit: one occurrence found entirely (all parts, all digits, street type included where written)
units.ppv_unit: one detector-positive span drawn from the blind split, adjudicated against source text only
units.specificity_unit: one pre-registered hard-negative occurrence in source text (order numbers, amounts, article/track IDs, dates in business context, bare toponyms, tool IDs) that must stay unmasked
naive_units_declared_unacceptable: repeated identical text or repeated template counted twice
a case counted once per field of the same person
correct value restored elsewhere used to excuse a wrong occurrence

known_vs_blind.principle: Everything listed as known_diagnostic has already been generated and/or read during development and therefore cannot be a blind acceptance set. Strict external scores stay published as their own, unchanged axis.

known_diagnostic_sets.name: bench/gate labels.json
known_diagnostic_sets.observed_discrepancy: gate README claims 600 hand labels (300 masked + 300 missed); the durable labels.json holds 587. 13 labelled occurrences are absent from the current file — reported as an observed mismatch, not resolved here.

known_diagnostic_sets.name: name-labels-blind-proposal (1215 MASSIVE person slots)
known_diagnostic_sets.status: PRIOR AI PROPOSAL — explicitly NOT accepted gold; may be used only as a candidate pool that two human labelers must re-label blind

known_diagnostic_sets.name: name15-verified (15 payloads)
known_diagnostic_sets.status: diagnostic witnesses for the known NAME defect class

future_blind_acceptance.construction: a NEW acceptance split generated at freeze time from the same generators with a fresh unseen seed, plus a fresh v6 slice once the v6 corpus exists; nothing in it is generated, read or tuned before freeze
future_blind_acceptance.custody: label files held by the owner/human custodian outside the agent read scope; implementation agents never read them

second_tier.name: pinned 359-ID holdout tier (agentpii5 ladder.json)
second_tier.caveat: membership is known and the run intersection is 0/359; that is NOT proof the historical holdout was never seen (B0 REVIEW limit 3)

prohibited: reusing prior proposal labels as accepted gold
calling an already-measured foreign corpus a fresh holdout
tuning after a blind split has been read

independence_requirements: each labeler sees only the source text and the versioned rules
neither sees detector spans, predictions, eval outputs or the other labeler's labels
the two label runs are recorded with separate actor ids, timestamps and file hashes
label_categories: PII_TYPE_BEARING (positive, with exact span and part decomposition)

case_rules.lexical_ambiguity_wife_name: «напиши жене» with no other name evidence is AMBIGUOUS_LEXICAL: it is neither a positive nor a detector false positive, and it is excluded from both the recall and the precision/PPV denominator. The miss risk is the owner's explicitly accepted trade (REMAINING-DECISIONS.md#L8), not a defect to count against the engine.
case_rules.fio_all_parts: every identifying part written is a labelled sub-unit (surname, given, patronymic, initial, declined/possessive form). All parts of one person share one identity cluster. A label that protects only part of a written FIO is recorded as PARTIAL, and whole coverage is measured per part.
case_rules.possessive_forms: «Жениного/Олино», confirmed by context as a person reference, is a positive whose fake must keep the grammar. A homonymous common word is NOT_PII.
case_rules.public_fictional_stage: public figures, fictional characters and stage names are positives (protected equally) but always labelled in their own stratum; the headline is published both with and without that stratum, never merged silently.
case_rules.brand_context: company, product, band or group token is not a NAME unless the occurrence's context identifies a person; borderline cases go to AMBIGUOUS_BRAND and to owner adjudication. No blacklist of words.
case_rules.address_entrance_floor: street, street type, house, building/корпус/строение, flat, entrance, floor belong to the person's address and are positives; a bare street reference without a number is GENERIC_TOPONYM (product does not mask it) and a bare city is not PII. Street type is part of the address identity.
case_rules.malformed_personal_ids: a checksum-invalid value that context/schema binds to a personal identifier is a positive (MALFORMED_PERSONAL_ID) and its form must be preserved, not repaired. A bare digit run of the same length without personal context is NOT_PII.
case_rules.order_and_business_numbers: amounts, order/article/track numbers, business dates, KPP/OGRN-type legal entity requisites are NOT_PII and feed the negative specificity frame.

labeling_protocol.dispute_handling: every disagreement between labeler A and labeler B is a dispute item queued to the owner with both labels, both spans, the applicable rule id and the source pointer; the owner's answer is recorded verbatim with a decision id and becomes part of the next rules version
labeling_protocol.stratified_agreed_review: a stratified random sample of the AGREED labels (strata = type × register, including the ambiguous and public strata) is re-checked by the owner; the sample is drawn before any engine number is seen
labeling_protocol.versioning: rules and labels are versioned files; a label change is a new version with a diff and a reason, never an in-place edit; the engine is always compared old/new on one gold version
labeling_protocol.self_certification_barred: the author of the labels cannot certify the result

ppv_design.question: of what the engine calls PII of this type, how much really is PII of that type, wholly covered?
ppv_design.frame: detector-positive spans inside the blind acceptance split; the frame is built once after freeze and its hash is recorded before sampling
ppv_design.sampling: stratified random sample per (type × register) with a published seed; the sample is fixed before any label is read
ppv_design.estimator: PPV = (TRUE_PII_TYPE_EXACT) / (all adjudicated sampled positives), with AMBIGUOUS_EXCLUDED removed from numerator and denominator and reported separately
ppv_design.ci: Wilson per slice + cluster bootstrap over identity/document clusters; design effect published
ppv_design.proposed_allocation: ≥300 adjudicated positive spans per headline type pooled over its main registers, with per-register minimum ≥60 so a single easy register cannot carry the type
barred: using the authored gold set as the PPV frame (it is the source of the positives, not the engine's output)

specificity_design.question: how much ordinary non-PII text does the engine mask?
specificity_design.frame: a pre-registered negative occurrence set, frozen before measurement: business numbers, order/track/article ids, amounts, business dates, bare toponyms, tool ids, roles and kinship words without a name
specificity_design.estimator: false-mask rate = masked negative occurrences / negative occurrences; reported per negative family, never as PPV
specificity_design.note: authored negatives shipped one per case are not independent hard-negative text; the negative frame must be re-drawn from real prose once the over-masking corpus is regenerated (ru_prose.jsonl is 0 bytes on this host)

ci_and_statuses.point_estimate_rule: report x/n and the point estimate; headline requires point estimate ≥99% per the owner's literal choice; the lower CI bound is published and is NOT required to be ≥99%
ci_and_statuses.interval: Wilson score 95% interval for independent binomial units
ci_and_statuses.clustered_interval: cluster bootstrap (10 000 resamples) over identity/document clusters; the design effect and the effective n are printed next to the interval
ci_and_statuses.paired_claims: McNemar for a paired engine-vs-engine difference, never as proof of no effect; a pre-registered TOST margin at δ=3pp is published for 'no effect' claims
ci_and_statuses.zero_denominator: NOT_MEASURED — an empty denominator can never produce 100% (the empty-`any([])` failure mode of the previous meter is explicitly guarded)
ci_and_statuses.insufficient_n: DESCRIPTIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT — below 300 independent positive units the slice is reported, never upgraded to a headline PASS
ci_and_statuses.no_averaging_rule: no average across heterogeneous types/registers may hide a failing slice

access_log.format: append-only JSONL, one row per read of a blind artifact
access_log.rule: any read of the blind split by an implementer invalidates that split for tuning; the read is never deleted, it is disclosed

immutability_and_access.separation: label files, blind split and detector outputs live in different directories with different owners; the manifest records which actor may read which

cost_estimate_human_review_items.currency: human review items (NOT money); one 'labeler-item' = one labeler judging one unit once; one 'owner-item' = one adjudication or re-check
cost_estimate_human_review_items.formula: labeler-items = 2 × (positive units + PPV sample + specificity sample + v6 units + temporary-secret units); owner-items = disputes(rate × units) + stratified agreed review(10% of agreed units); total = labeler-items + owner-items
cost_estimate_human_review_items.explicitly_not_a_budget_go: the owner still decides the authorized budget; this is a size estimate in review items, not dollars

v6_support_arithmetic.types_per_case_hypothesis: 2.72 for T≈40 types; 3.74 for 55 types (tz table, not a measurement)
v6_support_arithmetic.status: NOT_MEASURED — no generated v6 corpus exists on this host

unacceptable_alternatives: counting occurrences instead of independent identity clusters as support
pooling easy registers to reach 300 and calling the hard register covered
using the authored gold set as the PPV frame
treating MASSIVE person-slot as PII NAME by itself
treating the prior name-label proposal as accepted gold
declaring small slices a full acceptance, or dropping an unsupported type from the table
lower CI bound ≥99% as a substitute for the owner's point-estimate rule, or the reverse (softening the target because the CI is wide)
editing a blind split or a label file in place after it was read
reusing the already-measured foreign corpora as a fresh holdout

owner_questions.question: Accept (type, identity) as the independence cluster, with one primary occurrence per identity in the acceptance sample? Or require each identity to contribute exactly one occurrence, discarding the rest?
owner_questions.proposed: (type, identity) cluster + one primary occurrence sampled per identity
owner_questions.cost: the first option keeps more data; the second loses the multi-form evidence (declined, Latin, possessive) that the defect classes live in

owner_questions.question: May authored synthetic corpora carry the ≥300/type support, or must NAME/LOC headline support come from third-party human text?
owner_questions.proposed: authored corpora carry the product-scope headline; external corpora stay a separate strict axis
owner_questions.cost: third-party-only support is not reachable for PASSPORT/SNILS/INN/CARD/PLATE on any corpus on this host

owner_questions.question: For PASSPORT 63 / SNILS 128 / INN 144 / CARD 123 / PLATE 154 independent identities in the frozen 1800-case corpus: expand the corpus toward 300/type, or accept descriptive status for them now?
owner_questions.proposed: expand generation for the five underpowered types; keep them in the table as DESCRIPTIVE until then
owner_questions.cost: expansion multiplies annotation items; descriptive status delays a 99% claim for those five types

owner_questions.question: The planned 500-case v6 corpus projects to ≈25–34 independent units per new type — an order of magnitude below 300. Claim v6 per type, or per family, or expand the corpus to ≈4,400–6,100 cases?
owner_questions.proposed: headline per family with ≥300 independent units; per-type claims only where the corpus supports them
owner_questions.cost: per-type 99% for 55 types requires a corpus several times larger

owner_questions.question: Are public-figure, fictional and stage-name occurrences inside the 99% headline denominator or a separately published stratum?
owner_questions.proposed: protected and counted, but published as a separate stratum (the gate instrument already reports 'public' separately, 57 of 587 labels)
owner_questions.cost: inside the headline, one hard public-name case can move the number; outside it, a real protection class becomes invisible

owner_questions.question: Who generates and holds the fresh blind acceptance split, and may an agent generate it under a sealed procedure without reading labels?
owner_questions.proposed: human owner custody; agent may generate the text, never the labels
owner_questions.cost: requires owner time at freeze; without it there is no blind acceptance

owner_questions.question: Authorize ≈9,000–17,000 human review items, and the split between paid/owner labeling?
owner_questions.proposed: approve native+PPV+specificity first (≈9,000 items), v6 later
owner_questions.cost: the full number is the price of a genuine ≥300/type, blind PPV claim

owner_questions.question: May the pinned 359-ID tier serve as the secondary blind tier given its membership is known, or must acceptance use only a new split?
owner_questions.proposed: secondary tier with the 0/359 caveat printed; primary is a new split
owner_questions.cost: using it alone would repeat the historical access ambiguity

owner_questions.question: Does synthetic CVC/OTP/3DS material count as independent support for their ≥300 target, and who defines the operation contexts?
owner_questions.proposed: synthetic-only support, with an explicit 'synthetic' column kept separate from product-text support
owner_questions.cost: no real payment data may be used, so synthetic is the only available source; the owner must accept the different evidentiary weight

owner_questions.question: Are entrance/floor a required protected unit when written, or only when attached to a house number?
owner_questions.proposed: required when they belong to a personal address occurrence; a bare 'подъезд 3' with no address is ADDRESS_COMPONENT_ONLY and stays a negative
owner_questions.cost: the stricter reading over-masks building-service text

non_claims: this is a proposal, not an accepted manifest; O-DATA is still open
no engine quality, recall, precision or PPV number is asserted here
no production digest was verified; RG stays blocked on it
the prior name-label proposal is not accepted gold
nothing here implies G7, G11 or a release GO
